compatibility.strategy: Same v1 method/path/request/response core. Additive extension endpoints and typed error timing metadata. Response clients ignore unknown fields; requests remain strict on schema-backed routes.

operations.requestNote: No body schema in legacy core; clients omit body. No schema tightening in v0.2.

operations.authentication: conditional: bearer required for a link flow bound to same member
semantics: State consumed before provider exchange/owner validation; failure requires fresh start.
Existing restricted member may authenticate; GET /me yields RESTRICTED; mutation guards still apply.
Backend supports HTTPS dev-web callback configuration only; app callback binding and web handoff NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
At most 5 challenges/rolling hour and 60 seconds between successful DB challenge creations per phone; DB advisory lock.
Resend invalidates older challenges and ticket verification in same transaction. Delivery failure rolls back DB but uncertain external delivery is not proof of no SMS.
No runtime SMS adapter selected/wired; positive local tests are explicit doubles.
Expiry/wrong/missing/locked/replayed challenge deliberately share error; do not promise distinct invalid-vs-expired server diagnosis.
Maximum 5 wrong attempts; verify success does not renew registration ticket; no verification-receipt GET surface.
name.trim() nonempty; no gender/ageGroup/birthDate/nickname fields.
consents contain unique kind; TERMS+PRIVACY_CONSENT required, MARKETING optional; PRIVACY_POLICY must be ready but is not a grant input.
Automatic nickname on signup. Nonempty user nickname must remain pending for explicit subsequent profile PATCH and GET readback; do not silently drop.
Same principal or eligible phone wait exposes only own authenticated registration context rejoinAfter; different principal phone returns IDENTITY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED without old member info.
New member and customer number; unexpired restrictions resolve via principal and /me. expertRequested immediately activates if eligible and not restricted.
One-use rotation; revoked refresh replay revokes whole family. Serialize client refresh, never blindly retry on timeout; fresh social auth if uncertain.
No expectedVersion/idempotency key in request; each grant appends event including repeated identical grants.
Uncertain result GET /me/consents and exact version policies before explicit retry; records give current per-kind history head, not operation receipt.
Only MARKETING succeeds; removes advertising preference atomically. Repeated withdrawal may increment preference version even without new event.
Required-kind request never silently withdraws account; final confirmed withdrawal separate.
GET /me/consents plus GET /me/notifications readback; absent marketing record means no recorded grant, not a newly recorded WITHDRAWN event.
No reason/detail fields accepted or stored. UI selected reason/detail cannot be sent, discarded silently, or labelled saved; collecting/storage purpose requires policy+UIX decision.
Locks member, confirms once, disables expert/notifications, revokes all member sessions. Second request returns SESSION_INVALID, not idempotent receipt.

Lost response: GET /me with former bearer 200 means still active at read snapshot; 401 proves only invalid session, NOT withdrawal/time/retention. Remain outcome UNKNOWN; no new public account-status endpoint.
Unicode letters/numbers, 1..10 code points; no whitespace/special chars, no normalization promised. Last-write-wins, no expectedVersion. Exact GET /me readback required.

cors.localOrigins: Explicit KG_CORS_LOCAL_ORIGINS only; http localhost/127.0.0.1 with port. No env changed here.
cors.unknownOrigin: 403 without ACAO; allowed origin applies also 400/401/403/409/429/500

clientTime.format: UTC ISO8601 strings; retryAfter is absolute timestamp, retryAfterSeconds and HTTP Retry-After are relative seconds.
clientTime.serverTime: SMS success/rate/rejoin metadata anchored to PostgreSQL transaction now(). X-Server-Time is API onSend time, not same clock snapshot. Do not combine anchors.
clientTime.countdown: remaining=max(0,deadline-serverTime-(monotonicNow-monotonicRequestStart)); using full elapsed request age is conservative against transit and lock/send delays. Wall-clock skew never extends expiry. Keep fractional milliseconds internally; countdown display rounds down.
clientTime.suspend: Use continuous monotonic clock including sleep; if unavailable or process restored, invalidate challenge UI/require explicit resend. Never trust a restored local 60-second counter.
clientTime.authority: Server predicates alone decide validity; clock zero only blocks local submission. A clock/datetime display is guidance, not rejoin authorization.
clientTime.relativeCompatibility: expiresInSeconds:60 retained for v0.1-compatible displays; v0.2 clients use DB anchored absolute times. Missing/malformed required metadata is incompatible response, not success.
